title: $20 off Meals (Min 10 Meals), 2 Free Meal + Free Protein Cookie + $14.95 Shipping ($0 with Subscription) @ Muscle Diets
body:
Deal: $20 off Meals (Min 10 Meals), 2 Free Meal + Free Protein Cookie + $14.95 Shipping ($0 with Subscription) @ Muscle Diets

[bargainsinabundance] Is anyone seeing the 2 free meals and cookie in their cart when applying the LONG20 code?
[TheFifthRace] They will just send them to you. You don't get to choose what the 2 free ones are.
[Wolfenstein98k] You can choose by asking in the free text bit when ordering.
[otohadesu] Actually looks tasty and more balanced than the regular meal preps which have never heard of vegetables before.
[txb] Not sure how much of a deal this is considering their deal history shows a consistent 40% off
Skynet, what do you think? is this value?
[Shekster] "considering their deal history shows a consistent 40% off"
But their deal history shows the last deal posted was nearly a year ago?…
[skynet] That deal hasn't been valid for ages. That's like saying I should take youfoodz out of rotation too because they're far off their atl now.
[Kart] Would avoid buying from them - household purchased 2 seperate orders with about 10 meals in each order. Atleast 6 meals from each order was incorrect. This seems to be a recurring issue if you look at reviews.
Their solution was collecting the meals and providing a refund which is fine however it doesn’t seem like they care as seems to be an ongoing issue - why have specific meals with specific macros if you’re not going to adhere to the order.
Also, meals were not great, definitely on the lower end of quality/taste compared to the multiple other companies doing the same thing.
[bottlebug] Terrible customer service that is non existent. I would avoid this company like the plague. There’s literally zero customer support. The only time they ever responded to me was on my Google review where they said they tried to get me banned from PayPal for doing a charge back.
